summary: Climax Studios and Outright Games' Crayola-branded scooter sports game, mixing trick-combo challenges with paint/ink territory mechanics.

entries.title: Crayola Scoot
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release where owned; physical console copies for access preservation

emulation.notes: Run an owned Windows copy natively; console preservation depends on original hardware/physical copies.

primary.why: Crayola Scoot released for Windows, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One in 2018, and digital releases have since been delisted from all platforms. Windows is the highest-fidelity route if already owned, while physical console copies may be easier to preserve for access.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Windows copy if available; otherwise use a physical Switch, PS4, or Xbox One copy since digital storefront access has been delisted.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster; digital releases have been delisted across platforms.
